verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents an official "Admin SDK" (Reports API, Directory API) with REST reference pages, plus Apps Script for scripted automation. That is a first-party developer surface to build against. The evidence does not show language-specific client libraries, installation guides, or SDK coverage beyond the admin APIs. Missing for 10: evidence of official language client libraries (e.g., Python/Node/Java packages), SDK coverage across Workspace apps beyond admin, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Admin SDK Reports API lets administrators of enterprise domains to view the audit and usage reports of their domain.
Retrieves a paginated list of either deleted users or all users in a domain.
Anyone can use Apps Script to automate Admin console tasks in a web-based, low-code environment.
